hypothesis: H-CORRIDOR: faults missed by the USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary catalogue are carried by the same geophysical lineament signature as the mapped ones, so a model fitted on the public catalogue and applied OFF it will rank unmapped traces higher than the hand-built multi-line corroboration rule the nine focus sites all descend from.
mechanism: Gradient-boosted classifier on 56 independent geophysical/geometric bands plus 12 structure-tensor lineament fields; emission = top-ranked cells after 300 m non-maximum suppression, 200 m off-catalogue collar, at the champion's exact emitted mass of 37,654.
named_non_fault_mimic: Range-front and bedrock lithologic contacts: SGMC geologic-map faults are themselves largely (95.5%) outside the Quaternary catalogue, so a lineament model trained on Quaternary scarps can lock onto old bedrock structures that carry no geothermal permeability.

leakage_canary.design: 4 spatially disjoint fold classes (4x4 block grid taken modulo 4); model trained on 1.2 M sampled footprint cells, never on the held-out blocks.
leakage_canary.note: AUC measures detection of KNOWN catalogue faults, not of the hidden test faults.

champion_enrichment.question: Are the champion's dots at higher model probability than random footprint cells?

rule.dropped: traces in between, plus cells where a visible and a hidden trace overlap

holdout_dti.instrument: measurable proxy truth: USGS SGMC geologic-map faults >= 200 m outside the competition label raster (62649 cells), and the label raster itself
holdout_dti.verdict: NEGATIVE on the proxy instrument: the candidate does not beat the champion (-13.2% on P_SGMC2). The instrument itself has no demonstrated link to the leaderboard, so this is a failure to demonstrate superiority, not a demonstration of inferiority.

score_estimate.honest_headline: On the evidence available today the champion's 0.2778 is NOT expected to be beaten. The expected value of any new file in this covariate class is the peer-group median, 0.18; the upper end of the range, 0.28, requires this candidate's score surface to carry the family's yield, which no local instrument can confirm.

verdict_text: The file is format-clean, unique over 54 registry rasters and built by an independent, leakage-screened mechanism. It does NOT beat the 0.2778 champion on any measurable instrument. Promote only if the owner accepts a central estimate of 0.23 (range 0.18-0.28) against the champion's owner-reported 0.2778; the alternative is to spend the weekly slot on the champion's own lineage, which this repository is not permitted to copy.

sweep_deviation.pre_registered_rule: max P_SGMC2 s.t. P_LABELS <= 0.006709 and emitted mass == 37654
sweep_deviation.reason: alpha is a monotone transform and therefore a NO-OP under top-K selection, so the argmax row is not a model-driven placement at all - it is an arbitrary scan-order selection. The shipped row is the best model-driven member and is within 1.0% of the argmax. Disclosed rather than hidden.

promotion_status.reason: A parallel 2026-10-31 lane promoted gemsass2-s3-ring-binary-37654 (estimate 0.29, worst genuine-peer overlap 23.0%%, positive on the leakage-screened hide-and-recover instrument). Under the one-promoted-card invariant (IR-S-41) only one file may advertise a download, and this candidate is behind on every axis the two lanes share: estimate 0.23 vs 0.29, overlap 53.92%% vs 23.0%%, and negative on the off-catalogue proxy (-14.05%%) where S3-RING is positive. See IR-31-08.
